title: First-time user guardrail checks
agent_persona: A new user with mismatched gene identifiers, duplicate symbols, and malformed topic input.
goal: Verify common wrong inputs fail loudly or warn with actionable diagnostics instead of returning silent zero outputs.

commands.name: Build and install core wheel
commands.run:
python -m pip install --upgrade maturin
maturin build --release --manifest-path crates/rustscenic-py/Cargo.toml
WHL=$(ls target/wheels/rustscenic-*.whl | head -1)
python -m pip install "$WHL"

commands.name: Exercise user-facing diagnostics
commands.run:
python - <<'PY'
import warnings

import anndata as ad
import numpy as np
import pandas as pd

import rustscenic.aucell
import rustscenic.cistarget
import rustscenic.grn
import rustscenic.topics

rng = np.random.default_rng(0)

# Duplicate gene symbols should be explicit. GRN intentionally dedupes with a
# warning because that is safer for cellxgene/ENSEMBL-to-symbol input than
# failing a recoverable workflow.
dup = ad.AnnData(
    X=rng.normal(size=(20, 3)).astype('float32'),
    obs=pd.DataFrame(index=[f'c{i}' for i in range(20)]),
    var=pd.DataFrame(index=['SPI1', 'SPI1', 'GENE1']),
)
with warnings.catch_warnings(record=True) as caught:
    warnings.simplefilter('always')
    grn = rustscenic.grn.infer(dup, ['SPI1'], n_estimators=5, seed=0)
assert not grn.empty
assert any('duplicate gene name' in str(w.message).lower() for w in caught), [str(w.message) for w in caught]

# Mismatched regulon identifiers should emit a coverage warning and an empty
# regulon-activity matrix, not a plausible-looking zero-filled result.
adata = ad.AnnData(
    X=np.ones((10, 5), dtype='float32'),
    obs=pd.DataFrame(index=[f'c{i}' for i in range(10)]),
    var=pd.DataFrame(index=['A', 'B', 'C', 'D', 'E']),
)
with warnings.catch_warnings(record=True) as caught:
    warnings.simplefilter('always')
    auc = rustscenic.aucell.score(adata, [('bad_regulon', ['X', 'Y', 'Z'])], top_frac=0.4)
assert auc.shape == (10, 0), auc.shape
assert auc.attrs['regulon_coverage']['bad_regulon'] == (0, 3)
assert any('regulons have <' in str(w.message) or 'all 1 regulons dropped' in str(w.message) for w in caught), [str(w.message) for w in caught]

rankings = pd.DataFrame(
    np.tile(np.arange(5), (2, 1)),
    index=['M0', 'M1'],
    columns=['ENSG000001', 'ENSG000002', 'ENSG000003', 'ENSG000004', 'ENSG000005'],
)
with warnings.catch_warnings(record=True) as caught:
    warnings.simplefilter('always')
    out = rustscenic.cistarget.enrich(rankings, [('SPI1_regulon', ['SPI1', 'CEBPB'])], auc_threshold=0.0)
assert out.empty
assert any('none of their genes' in str(w.message) or 'all 1 regulons dropped' in str(w.message) for w in caught), [str(w.message) for w in caught]

empty = ad.AnnData(
    X=np.empty((5, 0), dtype='float32'),
    obs=pd.DataFrame(index=[f'c{i}' for i in range(5)]),
    var=pd.DataFrame(index=[]),
)
try:
    rustscenic.topics.fit(empty, n_topics=2)
except ValueError as exc:
    assert '0 peaks/genes' in str(exc), exc
else:
    raise AssertionError('empty topic input did not raise')

print('guardrail diagnostics OK')
PY
